big_picture.title: Nasdaq, S&P 500 Undercut Rally Lows; Nvidia Stock Climbs On Earnings Beat Late
big_picture.excerpt: The Dow Jones index sold off nearly 850 points Tuesday. Nvidia stock rallied on strong fiscal Q3 results after the close.
paragraphs: Broad-based weakness dragged the Dow Jones Industrial Average down by nearly 850 points Tuesday, leading the stock market lower as the Nasdaq composite and the S&P 500 undercut their recent rally lows.

The sell-off occurred before artificial intelligence titan Nvidia (NVDA) reported fiscal third-quarter results late Tuesday, just days after its high-profile founder Jensen Huang resigned as the company's chief executive. Nvidia beat Wall Street's expectations, driving the stock up roughly 3% during extended trade.
